correctness.rationale: For fixed limiting delta in (-1,1), exact random-priority exchangeability gives orientation probabilities a*C(b,3)/(a*C(b,3)+b*C(a,3)) and b*C(a,3)/(sum), with decrements (1,3)/(3,1). In s=(a+b)/N, d=(a-b)/N, accepted-step time k/N, s(t)=1-4t and interior drift ḋ=-4sd/(s^2+d^2); bounded increments plus uniform compact-interior drift, martingale concentration and Gronwall give the fluid limit. Differentiating |d|exp(-s^2/(2d^2)) along the ODE gives zero, and the first boundary s=|d| yields F(delta)=|delta| exp((1-delta^-2)/2). Once minority count <=epsilon*N, at most epsilon*N additional stars can be placed, controlling the terminal layer by 4epsilon; when delta=0 the symmetric fluid path d(t)=0 can be followed arbitrarily close to t=1/4, proving zero limit. Bounded U/N gives L1 convergence. The smooth flatness follows from e^(-1/(2delta^2)); m A-center and 9m B-center stars cover K_(28m,12m) although its jamming limit equals (2/5)e^(-21/8)>0. Independent finite rational physical-star versus count-chain distributions agree in 36 cases 1<=a,b<=6, symbolic derivative vanishes and exact finite-N means tend toward F; finite testing is corroboration only.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge original exact density for random greedy 3-leaf-star packing on dense unequal complete bipartite graphs. Unlike the regular-hypergraph bound and the sparse random-degree-sequence matching process, this has two nonregular macroscopic classes, a positive exact jamming fraction, and an infinitely flat balanced-limit response. Static star-factor theorems, lattice site RSA, deterministic released-packing invariants and complete-multipartite greedy independent sets do not imply this law. The inaccessible plausible 1986 article and an unindexed specialist solution remain priority risks rather than automatic disproof.

value.rationale: The exact universal fixed-imbalance vacancy function is a motivated kinetic invariant for a natural four-vertex star adsorption process, not an arbitrary parameter slice. Its C-infinity but nonanalytic flatness at balance sharply distinguishes it from power-law responses of three-vertex path deposition. The concrete perfect-cover witness quantifies an extensive failure of irreversible random greedy coverage despite deterministic packability. The explicit structural boundary between static matching capacity and kinetic adsorption has value even without fluctuations, finite-size error exponents, or a critical-window theorem.
